title: EnableAI - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script Enables or disables this actor's AI. Syntax: Function EnableAI(bool abEnable = true, bool abPauseVoice = false) native Parameters: - abEnable: Whether to enable or disable the AI. Default: True - abPauseVoice: Ignored if abEnable is True. If abEnable is False, setting this to True will pause the Actor's current voice audio, so it can be resumed upon re-enable. If left False, existing voice audio will play to completion. Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Turn off evil AI EvilActor.EnableAI(false)
; Turn on good guy's AI GoodActor.EnableAI()
; Freeze frame! JGeils.EnableAI(false, true) Utility.Wait(5) ; Now go! JGeils.EnableAI() See Also: - Actor Script
